top_signals.title: Stocks Waver as Fed Call and AI Earnings Loom: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks wavered ahead of earnings from two of the world’s biggest spenders on artificial intelligence and a US interest-rate decision where markets still see room for a hike. Brent rallied toward $90 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
